method: If the boiled eggs are meant to be warm, sort that first; otherwise keep chilled fillings properly cold. Slice the boiled eggs and keep them chilled until assembly, or warm them gently if this dish is being served hot.
Build the smoky flavour into the filling or dressing before it hits the bread, then taste it. It should taste good on its own before it becomes a sandwich.
Lay out the bread, spread right to the edges and add the wetter ingredients away from the bread where you can — nobody asked for a soggy lunch.
Pile in the boiled eggs, add the fresh bits for crunch, close it up and press gently so it holds together. Eat now, or wrap and chill promptly.
